eips.title: In-mempool signature and proof aggregation
eips.summary: Daisugi has been running a version of it; the call debated aggregation at length, and the next devnet will run without it.

moments.context: Antonio said Daisugi has been running a version of 8288, with the block builder aggregating about 20 signatures per second.
Antonio relayed Kev's three-stage plan: benchmark raw signatures without aggregation first, then block-builder aggregation, and eventually mempool aggregation.
Toni said in chat that with 8288 he hopes scaling can grow gradually as async aggregation improves.

eips.title: Resource-Based Intrinsic Transaction Gas
eips.summary: Jochem cited it as the EIP that reduces intrinsic transaction gas cost to 15k, relevant to pricing larger PQ signatures.

moments.context: Jochem cited EIP-2780 as lowering the minimum tx cost to 15k (from 21k) and suggested building signature size into intrinsic gas, then noted that is already part of tx cost.
